name: finance-guide
prompt: The attached images are STYLE references only (classic Korean MMORPG pixel art). For more of that style, browse these two games and study their character sprites: 바람의나라: 연 https://baramy.nexon.com/ and 도깨비의세계 https://dokkaebi.kakaogames.com/preregister/ . Learn from them: thick 1px dark outlines, dithered shading, saturated but limited palette, about 3 to 3.5 heads tall with a large head and voluminous hair, slight 3/4 top-down view, light coming from the upper left. Then draw a NEW original character (not a copy of any reference): the finance team's doer, the one who executes and defends the budget, in Joseon-fantasy attire - black hair tied back, light tan skin, two clearly visible dark eyes, a busy practical face. Clothing: a sleeveless navy jeonbok vest (전복, #2f4f7a) worn open over a white jeogori and white pants, a dark belt, black shoes. Holds a string of brass coins (엽전 꾸러미, coins threaded on a cord) in the right hand. Deliver the character as a WALK-CYCLE SPRITE SHEET, not a single picture: a grid of 4 rows x 4 columns. Rows top to bottom = facing south (toward viewer), west, east, north (back). Columns left to right = standing, left foot forward, standing, right foot forward. Each cell is exactly 32x48 logical pixels, so the whole sheet is 128x192 logical pixels. Inside every cell the character occupies at most 30x46 - leave a fully empty 1-pixel margin on all four sides of every cell. Anchor rule for all 16 cells: the soles of the planted feet sit on the same row (row 46 of the cell, counting from 0, i.e. one pixel above the cell bottom) and the torso is centered on the same vertical axis (column 16); the head may bob up 1 pixel while walking but the feet baseline never moves. The coin string stays in the right hand in every direction. Flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF) everywhere, no drop shadow, no text, no grid lines, no border. Render the 128x192 pixel art crisply, then upscale exactly 8x with nearest-neighbor so every logical pixel is a sharp 8x8 block on a 1024x1536 PNG, and give me that PNG to download.
